Toronto Dominion Bank decreased its stake in Viper Energy Partners Lp (VNOM) by 99.45% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Toronto Dominion Bank sold 99,449 shares as the company’s stock rose 37.18% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 551 shares of the oil & gas production company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $14,000, down from 100,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Toronto Dominion Bank who had been investing in Viper Energy Partners Lp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $3.21 billion market cap company. The stock increased 2.59% or $0.71 during the last trading session, reaching $28.16. About 534,497 shares traded.
